channel.title: 7News · Models
channel.description: Models channel: original summaries from official sources

item.title: SenseTime at APEC Leaders’ Week: diplomacy and city venues show AI apps
item.description: During Shenzhen’s 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Informal Meeting week, SenseTime showcased SenseRobot, Raccoon Work, Seko video agent, and a quadruped—event demos, not a model release.

item.title: ByteDance Seed STEM: retrosynthesis challenge opens
item.description: Seed STEM molecular retrosynthesis challenge: 10 real problems on Volcano Engine; first prize ¥50k; mainland China only; register by 4 Dec; CRO wet-lab validation.

item.title: Anthropic closes IPO; ANT opens on Nasdaq
item.description: Anthropic closes its IPO with the greenshoe fully exercised; Class A at $83, ~1.127B shares, ~$91.6B to the company; concurrent Class N private placement ~$26B; combined gross ~$119.5B.

item.title: OpenAI Business and Enterprise pricing page snapshot
item.description: OpenAI Business / Enterprise pricing navigation: Standard-seat workspace features, API credits, and custom Enterprise—model seat fees separately from API usage; verify live page prices.

item.title: DeepSeek API: deepseek-flash naming and peak/off-peak pricing
item.description: Call deepseek-flash (V4.1-Flash-1017); legacy names still accepted but billed at Flash rates; off-peak is half of peak; Flash cache-miss input ~$0.3/MTok at peak.

item.title: Anthropic Claude plans: Free, Pro, Max, and Ultra
item.description: Individual Claude plans: Free; Pro ~$17/mo annual ($20 monthly); Max $100; Ultra $200. Max/Ultra include $100/$200 monthly API credits—keep chat plans separate from API platform rates.

item.title: LlamaIndex ParseBench-2: a severity-aware document parsing benchmark
item.description: ParseBench-2 calibrates deterministic metrics to 330+ severity-labeled error types; corpus ~2.1k→4.3k; six dimensions including forms; LlamaParse Agentic Plus ~89.8 overall (vendor board).

item.title: Kimi WorldVQA: 3,500 questions on whether MLLMs recognize the entity
item.description: WorldVQA: ~3,500 image-QA pairs across 9 categories with head/tail splits; measures MLLM factual correctness; frontier models often under 50% on the tail; reports ECE/Slope calibration.

item.title: Liquid AI d1.2 / d1.2-ultra land on Vercel AI Gateway
item.description: Vercel: Liquid AI d1.2 / d1.2-ultra decision models on AI Gateway; Boolean / Choice / Score / Box; audio and image inputs; model IDs liquid/d1.2(-ultra).

item.title: GPT-Live 1.1 full-duplex speech lands on Vercel AI Gateway
item.description: Vercel: openai/gpt-live-1.1 via AI Gateway; full-duplex and interruptible; stronger transcription and cross-language timbre; same Live endpoint—usually just swap the model ID.

item.title: Google Dialogues: Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI era
item.description: A Dialogues podcast episode: Kent Walker with Walter Isaacson on collaboration behind historical breakthroughs and why judgment matters when information is always in your pocket—opinion talk, not a product launch.

item.title: Google Gemini 4 Neon lands on Vercel AI Gateway
item.description: Vercel Changelog: google/gemini-4-neon for coding and agents—multimodal, 1M context, tools, Search/Maps grounding, reasoning low–xhigh.

item.title: SenseTime 9M 2026 update: revenue +30.4%, generative AI accelerates
item.description: SenseTime’s nine-month update through 30 Sep 2026 reports revenue up 30.4% to RMB 3.79B and gross margin at 43.4%, plus SenseNova and token/agent commercialization notes (EN+CN posts merged).

item.title: OpenAI’s Performance Factory: Codex agents from alert to baseline check
item.description: OpenAI describes Performance Factory—configurable workflows where cloud Codex agents investigate performance alerts, propose fixes for human review, then verify recovery against baseline after deploy.

item.title: OpenAI partners with Groupe Figaro to surface Le Figaro in ChatGPT
item.description: OpenAI: strategic deal with Groupe Figaro so Le Figaro and sister titles are discoverable in ChatGPT via summaries and excerpts with links back; editorial independence retained; ChatGPT Enterprise planned internally.

item.title: OpenAI details chip-design gains with models, AMD, and Synopsys
item.description: OpenAI: Jalapeño vector/matrix standard-cell area ~−13%/−10%; up to ~14% PPA on AMD flagship GPU IP vs strong baselines; GPT-6.2 Astra leads RISC-V evals; GPT-Synopsys for EDA tools in progress.

item.title: Gemini 4 Neon: frontier capability tuned for high-frequency workflows
item.description: Google DeepMind launched Gemini 4 Neon on 18 Nov 2026—a 1M-context model priced below Carbon’s lane for complex coding, analysis, and enterprise delivery, with rollout across AI Studio, business, and Pro/Ultra surfaces.

item.title: Anthropic prices its IPO at $83 a share; ticker ANT expected on Nasdaq
item.description: On 18 Nov 2026 Anthropic priced its Class A IPO at $83.00 per share for about 980 million shares, with trading expected to begin the next day on Nasdaq under ANT.

item.title: SenseNova U1 Pro: Design Arena China #1, global #6 on image boards
item.description: SenseTime says SenseNova U1 Pro tops Design Arena’s China ranks for image generation and editing, placing sixth globally behind GPT Image 2.x variants, with a competitive preference-vs-price showing.

item.title: OpenAI GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol land on Vercel AI Gateway
item.description: Vercel Changelog: openai/gpt-6.2-astra and openai/gpt-6.2-sol on AI Gateway with Responses, fast mode, and Ultrafast (service_tier ultrafast); Astra Ultrafast output cited ~60% below GPT-6 Astra.

item.title: SenseTime ships SenseNova Loop-9B GA with looped depth
item.description: SenseTime’s SenseNova Loop-9B GA: ~9B params, shared middle layers run twice for 56 layer passes, 512K context; cites NL2Repo/AIDABench near Qwen3.8-27B; weights and AWQ 4bit open.

item.title: OpenAI deepens NATO and allied cyber defense via Daybreak
item.description: OpenAI: Daybreak cyber models for NCIA—up to ~300B raw tokens/month cited; support for CCDCOE Crossed Swords AI-agent training; ENISA, Ukraine, and CERT Polska among allied examples.

item.title: OpenAI ships GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol for hard projects and everyday work
item.description: OpenAI: GPT-6.2 Astra for complex multi-step projects, Sol for everyday coding and agents; Astra API at $8/$40 per M in/out ($0.40 cached), Sol keeps 6.1 Sol rates; ChatGPT Work, Codex, and API at launch.

item.title: OpenAI updates Astra for Law; Enterprise can request Trusted Access
item.description: OpenAI: GPT-6.2 Astra legal config ~20.8% full-credit on Harvey LAB-AA; ~53.8% full-credit on Vals Legal Research; index +~34%; ChatGPT Enterprise Trusted Access and API request form.

item.title: Tencent Hy4 Flash on Vercel AI Gateway at 50% off through Nov 29
item.description: Vercel Changelog: tencent/hy4-flash keeps the Hy4 feature set at roughly a tenth of the token price; 50% off input, cached input, and output through 29 Nov 2026.

item.title: OpenAI expands free ChatGPT access for academic researchers toward 200k
item.description: OpenAI: ChatGPT for Academic Researchers opens applications 23 Nov—50k first-come grants (Plus for recipient + up to two collaborators); program goal 200k; data not used for training by default.

item.title: Alibaba Qwen4-Max lands on Vercel AI Gateway
item.description: Vercel Changelog: alibaba/qwen4-max for coding and long-running agents—image input, 1M context, tools, structured outputs; Alibaba cites ~35% fewer tokens vs Qwen3.8-Max on Work360.

item.title: DeepSeek opens App capabilities on the API: search, files, links, and voice
item.description: DeepSeek’s 13 Nov 2026 API note makes App-parity features callable: V4.1-Flash built-in web search, URL reading, file parsing, and safety checks, plus standalone OCR/ASR/TTS and an open-source demo.

item.title: Cohere closes AISLE deal and adds cubic to its sovereign AI platform
item.description: Cohere: completes the AISLE acquisition for autonomous vuln discovery/remediation and welcomes the cubic code-review team—its fourth strategic M&A this year for sovereign AI.

item.title: Inkling 2 Small lands on Vercel AI Gateway
item.description: Vercel Changelog: thinkingmachines/inkling-2-small on AI Gateway for coding agents and knowledge work—text and image in, text out.

item.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen arrives on Vercel AI Gateway
item.description: Vercel Changelog: google/gemini-4-hydrogen succeeds 3.8 Flash on AI Gateway with stronger agentic coding, knowledge work, and tool orchestration.

item.title: Moonshot open-sources Kimi K2.6 for long-horizon coding and swarms
item.description: Moonshot releases open Kimi K2.6 with long-horizon coding, Agent Swarm (up to ~300 sub-agents), and proactive-agent focus via Kimi.com, App, API, and Kimi Code.

item.title: Google ships Gemini 4 Hydrogen for everyday agentic coding
item.description: DeepMind/Google: Hydrogen targets daily agentic workflows; AA Index 51 at default high (54 at xhigh); flat API pricing $1.50/$7.50 per M in/out across 1M context.

item.title: Moonshot’s PerceptionBench isolates atomic visual perception in MLLMs
item.description: Kimi Team’s PerceptionBench: 10 atomic skills mined from failures across 42 benches, 3,000 questions; none of 16 frontier MLLMs reach 60%, with hallucination weakest on average.

item.title: OpenAI says 20,000+ veterans claimed a free year of ChatGPT Plus
item.description: OpenAI’s update on free ChatGPT Plus for veterans and transitioning servicemembers: more than 20,000 claims in the past year, plus Academy trainings.

item.title: DeepMind ships AlphaGenome 2: cell-type–conditioned DNA effect prediction
item.description: Google DeepMind’s next DNA model predicts under a chosen biological condition and roughly doubles causal-variant recall on single-cell tests; research API open, commercial use in private preview.

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon lands on Vercel AI Gateway at 50% off through Nov 30
item.description: Vercel Changelog adds google/gemini-4-carbon on AI Gateway—framed for engineering, agentic work, and cyber defense—with 50% off through 2026-11-30.

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon is live: heavier agentic and cyber workloads
item.description: Google DeepMind opens Gemini 4 Carbon to developers, enterprises, and Ultra users. It sits above Argon for long-horizon agents, with intro pricing through 30 Nov 2026.

item.title: Anthropic launches the roadshow for its proposed IPO
item.description: Anthropic began the roadshow for a proposed IPO of about 825 million Class A shares at an expected $70–$78 range, seeking a Nasdaq listing under ANT.

item.title: Moonshot launches Kimi K3, an open 2.8T-class frontier model
item.description: Moonshot’s Kimi K3 is a 2.8T-parameter model with native vision and a 1M-token context, built on KDA and Attention Residuals; products and API are live while weights follow the official schedule.
